clips.title: The story
paras: At Oracle Glade on Teldrassil, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak watches over the northern groves. She guards the enchanted waters and woodland wildlife.

Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak keeps watch in Oracle Glade, one of Teldrassil's most secluded reaches. Far from Darnassus, she serves the Sentinel army among ancient trees and ethereal springs, guarding the wilderness from disturbance.

Disharmony stirs among Teldrassil's creatures despite the tree's sacred birth. Arynia asks passing adventurers and young night elves to look into local troubles, from strange wildlife to mystical signs around the enchanted springs.
